query: Someone spread a false statement to damage my reputation. What offence may apply?

gold_references.label: Section 356
gold_references.role: defamation - making imputation intending to harm reputation

required_points: Section 356 defines defamation as making or publishing any imputation concerning any person intending to harm, or knowing it likely to harm, the reputation of such person.

The imputation must lower the moral or intellectual character of the person in the estimation of others, lower their character in respect of caste or calling, lower their credit, or cause the person's body to be believed in a loathsome state.
Spreading a false statement to damage reputation may amount to defamation.
optional_points: Section 356 has several exceptions; the final determination depends on whether any exception applies.
forbidden_points: Defamation only applies to written statements.
Truth can never be a defence to defamation.
